title: Maryland PSC Order No. 92471 (Case No. 9833)
text:
COMMISSIONERS 

KUMAR P. BARVE

ODOGWU OBI LINTON 
RYAN C. MCLEAN 

S T A T E O F M A R Y L A N D 

PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 

June 22, 2026 

The application of the Town of Thurmont,
Maryland for authority to increase its rates for 
electric service. 
* 

* 
Case No. 9833 

VIA EMAIL 

To All Parties of Record: 

The Proposed Order of Public Utility Law Judge filed in the above-entitled matter 
on June 5, 2026 was not appealed by any party, nor has the Commission modified or 
reversed the Proposed Order or initiated further proceedings into this matter. Accordingly, 
on June 19, 2026 the Proposed Order became a final order of the Commission, and today it 
was entered on the docket of the Commission as Order No. 92471. 

Very truly yours, 

/s/ Kathleen Berends 

Kathleen Berends 

Administrator
